posts.text: Today’s lunch specials: BBQ PORK RIBS & MEAT LOAF. If you need to place an order, please give us a call. 910-327-2011 910-327-7551. 119 Hall Pt. Rd. Sneads Ferry, NC 28460

This weekend is looking tasty! Fresh local oysters are on the menu, steamed to perfection and served up just the way we like them! Nothing beats oyster season on the coast. Come hungry and enjoy a little taste of Topsail at The Breezeway!

We hope you are hungry. More fresh Salmon means blackened Salmon Alfredo! Plus: New England clam chowder and lobster bisque. Grouper basket or appetizer, Clam strip basket or appetizer, Flounder basket or sandwich, Conch fritters, Scallop basket or appetizer,
